newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet after hours.

text.p: Trading activity was light after hours, traders said.
"It's very quiet. There's nothing going on right now," said a trader.
The New York Stock Exchange said no stocks were unavailable for after hours trade for news.
The NYSE said session one volume was 1,300 shares, compared to 3,500 shares Tuesday. Session two volume was 840,600 versus 2,757,400.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
